description: We are team Al-Nujoom, participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge with Lim's Water Mission game.
summary: Lim's Water Mission is an interactive educational web game developed by Team Al-Nujoom for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. The project focuses on water conservation, inspired by ISS ECLSS water recycling systems and GRACE-FO telemetry data. Through an engaging three-level gameplay featuring an astronaut character named Lim and a water-drop companion, players learn critical concepts about water management, sustainability, and resource recycling in space and on Earth.
details: Project Overview & Functionality: "Lim's Water Mission" is an interactive, three-level educational web game developed by Team Al-Nujoom for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. The project is designed to raise awareness about water conservation, drawing inspiration from the International Space Station's ECLSS water recycling systems and GRACE-FO telemetry data. How It Works & Impact: Players guide an astronaut character named Lim and a water-drop companion through interactive missions to manage, recycle, and conserve water resources. The game bridges complex space telemetry with engaging gameplay, educating users on sustainability challenges both in space and on Earth. Tools, Technologies & Creativity: The project was built using modern web development tools and technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and Replit), integrating generative AI methodologies for code prototyping and design enhancement. Team Al-Nujoom prioritized user accessibility, engaging storytelling, and educational impact to make complex NASA data intuitive and fun for all ages.
